response.sql: SELECT mt.Name, AVG(t.UnitPrice), AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS FLOAT) / CAST(t.Milliseconds AS FLOAT)) FROM Track t INNER JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY mt.Name

assumptions.assumption: Tracks with NULL Bytes values are excluded by the WHERE clause, since NULL > 10323804 evaluates to false in SQL.
